name_input: ROLLFORM EQUIPMENT PRIVATE LIMITED; M/S ROLL FORM EQUIPMENT PVT LTD
note: RISK-ONLY REVIEW. Tooling limitation: the DuckDuckGo/searx search backend returned 'Connection refused' on every attempt (4 tries), so no open-web negative-news, court-database (eCourts/NCLT), regulator or credit-rating search could be executed. OFAC SDN consolidated CSV (treasury.gov/ofac/downloads/sdn.csv) was retrieved but the fetch is truncated to 6000 chars, so a full-string scan for 'ROLLFORM' could not be completed; the OFAC Sanctions List Search UI is a JS form and returned no queryable results via GET, and its /api/Search endpoint returned HTTP 404. Therefore sanctions_hit, court_cases, rating, news_risk and rf_supply are all null = NOT VERIFIED, not 'clean'. What was actually verified: the company's own website rollformindia.com is live and describes an operating manufacturer of tube mills, cold saw cut-offs, slitting lines and roll forming lines, 'serving the steel tube & pipe industry since 1992', with technical collaboration with M/s Manfred Olk Rohrwerkstechnik GmbH & Co. KG (Germany) and Simec s.r.l. (Italy). Its News page (rollformindia.com/news) lists: participation in Tube India International Expo 2024, Mumbai, 27-29 Nov 2024; orders for Cold Saws from tube manufacturers 'in India, Africa and the Middle East'; a commissioned tube mill at Goodluck Steel Tubes' automotive pipe facility; and an off-line pipe cutting range with Simec. No mention anywhere on the site of Russia, CIS, Kazakhstan or any sanctioned destination - but absence of mention is not evidence of absence. No evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS was found; status: not found, unverified. No credit rating found in public sources (null). No court cases, regulator actions or negative news could be checked (null). Per project rules, nothing here is a rejection ground; the company remains in the base. RECOMMENDED FOLLOW-UP (not done due to call limit): manual OFAC/EU/UK/BIS entity-list string check, eCourts and NCLT party search, and a credit-rating lookup (CRISIL/ICRA/CareEdge) - all currently outstanding.
